name: Unindexed Foreign Key Filter
query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 42
description: Performs a full table scan on 200k orders because customer_id secondary index is omitted.

name: Non-Sargable Year Function
query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2024
description: Applying YEAR() function wraps column and defeats B-tree index seeks.

name: Leading Wildcard Customer Search
query: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%@gmail.com'
description: Leading wildcard forces full table scan across all customer rows.

name: Unindexed Multi-Table Join
query: SELECT c.name, o.id, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'PENDING'
description: Orders table lacks index on status and customer_id resulting in expensive join scans.

name: Cartesian Join Products Orders
query: SELECT * FROM products JOIN orders WHERE products.category = 'Electronics' LIMIT 100
description: Missing explicit ON condition causes Cartesian product evaluation.

name: Aggregating 500k Rows Without Filter
query: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id
description: Full scan over all 500k order items without WHERE filtering.

name: SELECT * With Large Range
query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE total_amount BETWEEN 50.00 AND 500.00
description: Wide range query using SELECT * causing massive I/O read volume.

name: Correlated Subquery in WHERE
query: SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) > 10
description: Executes subquery for every customer row without indexed lookups.

name: Order By Without Limit
query: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY order_date DESC
description: Filesort across all completed orders without LIMIT clause.

name: Distinct Over Unindexed Join
query: SELECT DISTINCT c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.shipping_state = 'CA'
description: DISTINCT combined with join creates temporary table deduplication overhead.

name: Indexed Primary Key Join With Filter
query: SELECT c.id, c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id = 150
description: Fast primary key lookup on customers but scans orders for customer_id.

name: Status Filter With Limit
query: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' LIMIT 25
description: Simple unindexed filter mitigated by early termination via LIMIT.

name: Order Date Range Projection
query: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-02-01'
description: Clean sargable date range but requires table scan without secondary index.

name: Specific Column Projection Join
query: SELECT c.name, c.email, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id BETWEEN 100 AND 200
description: Specific column list reduces memory bandwidth on join.

name: City Filter With Grouping
query: SELECT shipping_city, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE shipping_state = 'TX' GROUP BY shipping_city
description: Aggregate grouped by city with state filter.

name: Primary Key Exact Lookup
query: SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE id = 1050
description: Instant single-row const seek via InnoDB clustered primary key index.

name: Covering Projection via Primary Key
query: SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE id IN (10, 20, 30, 40, 50)
description: Direct primary key range scan retrieving only needed projected columns.

name: Indexed Order Item by PK
query: SELECT id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price FROM order_items WHERE id = 45000
description: Point lookup on clustered index.

name: Sargable Order Range With Limit
query: SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount, order_date FROM orders WHERE id > 190000 AND order_date >= '2024-06-01' LIMIT 50
description: Bounded ID range scan with LIMIT.

name: Aggregated Order Total for Single Customer
query: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS spent FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 120 GROUP BY customer_id
description: Grouped aggregate targeting single customer record.
